prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1287; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported. Before we begin, do you consent to this call being recorded?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Please state where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was in a parking lot in Conroe, Texas, at a shopping center. I had just pulled into a spot near the main entrance.

Q: Can you describe what you were doing right before the impact?

A: I was backing out of the space slowly. I checked my mirror and I didn't see anything coming, but then I heard a loud bang on the driver's side.

Q: Which vehicle hit yours?

A: A pickup truck was moving down the aisle. It came around the end of the row a bit fast, and the front of it clipped my rear door.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any pain or notice injuries at the scene?

A: Not right away. I felt a jolt in my right shoulder, but I thought it was just from turning around. By that evening the shoulder was really sore and I could barely lift my arm above my head.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day, and I have a follow-up appointment with my doctor scheduled for later this week.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm hoping this gets sorted out quickly, because the shoulder is affecting my work.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
